quest.title: Cost-Effective Hook
quest.description: Kayvan the angler seems to be having some trouble...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x3

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: *sigh* Please help us deal with the Slimes...

dialogues.speaker: Helbet
dialogues.text: This would be the last of the relics. Please find the materials to help Mr. Kayvan do his job.

dialogues.speaker: Helbet
dialogues.text: Please, do me a favor! I could really use your help!

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: No can do. Please go.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, what's with the quarrel?

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: Hey, outlander, care to help me persuade this lady here?

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: She came to ask me to salvage some antiques. Has been bugging me all day.

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: She not only scared away my fish but also wants to keep taking up my time.

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: Miss, why such a hurry? Trying to rake it in with the antiques?

dialogues.speaker: Helbet
dialogues.text: No, Mr. Kayvan. I am Helbet with the Akademiya.

dialogues.speaker: Helbet
dialogues.text: The Akademiya found those antiques and I'm responsible for keeping them.

dialogues.speaker: Helbet
dialogues.text: But there was an accident on the ship transporting the relics. Some dropped off the ship, floating down the river to the lower reaches.

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: Then go to a professional salvage team! Why bother a fisherman like me?

dialogues.speaker: Helbet
dialogues.text: It takes too long to find a suitable salvage team. I've heard people call you "Supreme Hookshot" and that you fish lost items up from the river nearly every day.

dialogues.speaker: Helbet
dialogues.text: And you've been fishing around a lot, so I thought I'd ask you to try casting your rod, see if you could get the relics...

response.speaker: Kayvan
response.text: Ahem, Miss Helbet, I feel sorry for what you have been through. But I'm only a fisherman.

response.speaker: Kayvan
response.text: I cast my rod to catch fish and fish only.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You haven't caught even one fish...

response.speaker: Kayvan
response.text: Ahem! I've been training to do that with the pure thought in mind. Never thought about hooking other stuff.

response.speaker: Kayvan
response.text: So you'd better find someone else.

response.speaker: Helbet
response.text: Eh... Eh?

response.speaker: Helbet
response.text: Then... How about this, I won't ask you to hook the relics for me, I just need you to go fishing at another place. What do you say?

response.speaker: Helbet
response.text: I'm paying you to catch fish! Please, I'm counting on you!

response.speaker: Kayvan
response.text: Ugh... I am a fisherman! A fisherman!

choices.text: It's nice to fish at a new spot.

response.speaker: Helbet
response.text: Come on, please help me. I've prepared your payment already.

response.speaker: Kayvan
response.text: You guys are incessant... Fine, I guess I'll do that for a change. Where do you want me to fish?

response.speaker: Helbet
response.text: Many thanks! Just follow me!

response.speaker: Kayvan
response.text: Same as before, Traveler. Please help me find some materials for the baits.

response.speaker: Kayvan
response.text: Let me think... I'll be using Mint this time. But it needs to be collected from my usual spot.

response.speaker: Kayvan
response.text: I've marked the general area. I'll leave it to you. After you bring the materials, I will go over the payment in detail with you.

response.speaker: Kayvan
response.text: Miss Helbet and I are going to the fishing spot first. We'll meet there.

choices.text: Well, a fisherman hooks this and that.
Well, if it's Kayvan who casts the rod...

response.speaker: Kayvan
response.text: I cast my rod only to get fish, okay!?

talks.objective: Look for the materials that Kayvan needs
Give the bait materials to Kayvan

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: Did you find the materials?

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: That's pretty quick! Thanks!

dialogues.speaker: Helbet
dialogues.text: Please start fishing, or the relics could... I mean the fish...

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: No rush. I need to feel the flow of the water to ensure I can cast the rod with the peace of mind.

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: Let's see what big fish lies for me here...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Kayvan prepares the bait and begins fishing.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Kayvan catches a wet package after a long while.

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: What do I have here...?

dialogues.speaker: Helbet
dialogues.text: This is... Let me check!

dialogues.speaker: Helbet
dialogues.text: This is it! One of the lost antiques! Unscathed. No aquatic creature has gotten inside...

dialogues.speaker: Helbet
dialogues.text: You actually hooked a relic! You are really the Supreme Hookshot!

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: Is that a compliment? Doesn't really make me happy...

dialogues.speaker: Helbet
dialogues.text: Well, the relic at the first spot has been salvaged, and the next... fishing spot is just west of here.

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: Let's get rolling. The sooner I can go back and catch real fish in peace, the better.

dialogues.speaker: Helbet
dialogues.text: No problem. Please follow me!

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: Traveler, we'll be using Harra Fruit as bait this time. My gut tells me this is the most suitable material.

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: I know a place where the Harra Fruit is the finest. I'll show you the location.

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: We'll head off first. Let's meet at the next fishing spot.

talks.objective: Look for the materials that Kayvan needs
Give the bait materials to Kayvan

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: You are back. Found the special material?

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: Okay. Here goes the fishing again.

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: I need to concentrate. Please don't make any noise...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Kayvan begins to focus on fishing...

dialogues.speaker: Helbet
dialogues.text: Argh! Look over there! So many Slimes!

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: Huh? I've never seen anything like this before.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What's with all the troubles when Mr. Kayvan is fishing...

dialogues.speaker: Helbet
dialogues.text: You guys are so good! Thanks a lot!

dialogues.speaker: Helbet
dialogues.text: When all the relics are recovered, I will apply for more compensation as your payment.

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: You just don't believe I can hook a real fish, do you...?

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: Wait, something big is on the hook!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Kayvan lifts the rod hard...

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: What's this...?

dialogues.speaker: Helbet
dialogues.text: Ah, this is another pack of the relics! Great!

dialogues.speaker: Helbet
dialogues.text: I didn't expect it to go so well. You've recovered two relics now! What a hook, Mr. Kayvan!

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: I shouldn't have said that...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: There are tons of fish in the river. Not so for relics.

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: But I haven't caught a single fish!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Look at the bright side. We've recovered the relics. It's a good thing.

dialogues.speaker: Helbet
dialogues.text: The last fishing spot is near Vimara Village. A much safer place for fishing. Let's get moving.

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: Yeah, yeah. Off we go...

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: This is so weird. Is there something wrong with my bait, or the way I fish...?

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: Never mind. Traveler, please find some fresh Zaytun Peaches for me this time.

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: Since it's the last spot, I'll have to use my special bait.

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: I'm counting that on you, Traveler.

talks.objective: Look for the materials that Kayvan needs

dialogues.speaker: Helbet
dialogues.text: I'm counting on you two. If you find the material, give it to Mr. Kayvan, so he can get to work as soon as possible.

talks.objective: Look for the materials that Kayvan needs

dialogues.speaker: Helbet
dialogues.text: I'm counting on you two. If you find the material, give it to Mr. Kayvan. Time is pressing!

talks.objective: Look for the materials that Kayvan needs

dialogues.speaker: Helbet
dialogues.text: Please help me drive away the Slime! They could ruin our salvage!

talks.objective: Give the bait materials to Kayvan

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: That was fast! You found the special material?

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: Looks like everything's going well. Time for one last fishing attempt.

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: Whew... Third time's a charm. Please let me hook some fish! Even a teeny-tiny one will do.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Kayvan prepares the bait and begins fishing...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: A third soaked package is pulled out of the water by the wire after a while.

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: See it yourself... I don't want to look at it...

dialogues.speaker: Helbet
dialogues.text: Alright, let me take a look... Good, there's no damage at all.

dialogues.speaker: Helbet
dialogues.text: Perfect, Mr. Kayvan! The power of Supreme Hookshot, again!

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: Yeah, haha... As long as you have what you wanted...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Three packs with three hooks... Yet not even one fish came to bite the hook...

choices.text: That's what makes Mr. Kayvan so impressive.

response.speaker: Kayvan
response.text: Hey! I've been serious about catching a big fish, not antiques!

response.speaker: Kayvan
response.text: Call me bad at fishing or whatever...

response.speaker: Kayvan
response.text: But it's been so many times! Even one with the worst luck should have gotten some fish!

response.speaker: Kayvan
response.text: But none's ever come to me!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... This is strange indeed...

response.speaker: Helbet
response.text: Well, Mr. Kayvan, if you are interested, I can introduce you to a researcher who specialized in fishing.

response.speaker: Helbet
response.text: He's worked on the design of many popular fishing rods and baits.

response.speaker: Helbet
response.text: I don't know exactly why you couldn't hook a fish. But... It doesn't hurt to ask a professional.

response.speaker: Helbet
response.text: Maybe he'll be interested in you.

response.speaker: Kayvan
response.text: You mean interested in the fact that I lift my hook with everything but fish?

response.speaker: Kayvan
response.text: But you are right. This is my chance to see what's wrong with my skill.

response.speaker: Helbet
response.text: Sure. Leave the rest to me!

response.speaker: Kayvan
response.text: But do some bookworm researchers really know fishing?

response.speaker: Kayvan
response.text: Oh... I almost forgot! Thank you for the help, Traveler. This is your payment. Please take it.

choices.text: This is certainly one of a kind I guess...
